hookText: mobile-agent-testers: Claude Code agents beta-test your app on iOS Simulators

beats.say: pierridotite's open-source workflow gives each Claude Code agent its own simulator or emulator and a persona, such as an iPhone SE in Swedish at the largest text size.
Modes include exploring like a new user, driving one feature end to end, reproducing a bug report on every device, writing an improvement report and comparing two builds.
On LocalSend, 20 agents on 10 Android and 10 iOS devices in 14 languages reported 46 distinct bugs in 69 minutes for $4.62.
